name: Nova Scotia
description: A peninsula and island (Cape Breton) of Appalachian uplands, never far from the sea: rocky Atlantic shore, Fundy shore and Annapolis Valley, the Cape Breton Highlands plateau. Halifax is on a deep Atlantic harbour; the main airport is inland.
